prompt:
Create one polished art-direction mockup of the item details popup for our mobile comic-fantasy tower-defense game Kingdom Watch / 王国守望. This is a new preview image, not an implementation or a copy of another game's skin.
Input images: image 1 is a reference only for the compact icon + item name + description hierarchy. Image 2 is a reference only for clearly separating item overview, description and acquisition. Image 3 is OUR EXISTING GOLD COIN ICON, a faceted gold coin with a crown emblem; faithfully use its design in the mockup instead of the other games' coin emblems.
Canvas: portrait 3:4. A single large centered item modal on a subdued, dimmed and softly defocused fantasy game inventory/lobby background. No phone hardware, no external labels, no side-by-side options. Frame the complete popup with comfortable outer margins. Refined finished 2D mobile-game UI illustration, crisp practical screen layout, suitable for a real small-screen game.
Our visual language: confident western comic fantasy, bold clean ink contours, deliberate simple beveled facets, very restrained halftone accents. Cream parchment #F5E8CD / #FFF5E1, ink navy #29313B / #19222C, warm gold #FFC848. A thin warm-gold rim and one subtle folded-paper corner; no elaborate baroque scrolls, heavy wood, metal chains, excessive studs, photographic texture, neon, sci-fi circuitry or frost cap. The header is dark desaturated navy with a quiet gold edge, body is light warm parchment with plenty of clear reading space. A convincing but restrained handcrafted finish, not a generic rounded web dashboard.
Layout: upper title ribbon '物品详情', a small integrated close X at the upper-right. Beneath it, a large crown-coin illustration in a tasteful pale-gold square item socket on the left; on the right a prominent dark title '金币', a smaller secondary line '通用货币', and an ownership line '拥有：12,680' where the number is visually emphasized in warm gold/brown. Below, two well-separated sections with small understated illustrated emblems and slim rules, not giant boxed text blocks. First section has the heading '道具说明' and the EXACT short text '王国中广泛使用的基础货币。' and '可用于英雄培养、装备强化与商城购买。' on clean readable lines. Second section has heading '获取途径', with ONE neat cream inset source row: small crossed-swords/fortress icon, text '主线关卡', subtext '通关与击杀可获得', and a discreet gold action capsule '前往 ›' on the right. At the bottom, one broad but not oversized dark-navy button with cream text '关闭', a thin warm-gold outline and subtle lower shadow. Keep the composition compact and balanced; no large vacant bottom area, no scroll bar for this short item.
Text: all Chinese must be accurately legible, natural UI fonts with clear hierarchy. Do not introduce rarity, use-level requirements, battle-pass, patrol-car, arbitrary stats, sale tags or extra controls. No other visible text, logos or watermark. Item counts are sample mockup values. Deliver one high-quality finished preview.
